issues: Built in 480×270 design space: the opening ring was only ~160px across, nowhere near full-frame energy, and the final lockup filled 1/6 of the width
The BRAND wordmark felt like a placeholder in weight and tracking, and the tagline was a 12.5px-class line that could not be read
Pure black with a faint purple halo; the collapse had almost no sense of speed, and the performance and standard states differed only in colour
The tagline used a clashing red, outside the neon-violet palette
changes: Aurora look (violet-pink night with dust): frame 1 is a 1240px iridescent split ring that bleeds off top and bottom, with a violet-pink-ice gradient stroke and a wide glow

The collapse is slow-then-violent with a hard brake (10x in 28f), a 7% brake overshoot and one shockwave; the ring is redrawn at its true radius each frame (no upscaling blur), the stroke thins sublinearly, and three radius ghosts give radial motion blur at peak speed

Performance to standard state: the gaps heal, the iridescence crossfades to a cream solid ring and an iridescent pearl pops into the centre, keeping the show colours inside the mark (fictional brand Nacre)

The lockup is laid out for 1080p: a 190px NACRE wordmark slides out from behind the icon letter by letter (3f stagger, focus pull), then a single pearl sheen clipped to the glyphs sweeps across; the tagline LIGHT IN EVERY LAYER is 32px, wide-tracked accent pink
132→138f, with a 42f end hold carrying a 1.5% slow push and breathing light
